description: Exploring space and designing a space mission game .
summary:
**ASTRION — Advanced Spacecraft Technology, Research & Interactive Orbital Navigation** is an interactive space mission design and simulation platform that brings the spacecraft engineering experience into an accessible digital environment.

ASTRION offers a professional, immersive Engineering Workspace where users can explore spacecraft components, assemble custom rockets, and select mission-ready sample vehicles for Earth orbit, Moon and Mars missions. Its three AI-powered capabilities—**Blueprint AI, ASTRION AI and AI-assisted mission intelligence**—help users examine technical blueprints, understand spacecraft designs and interpret mission performance.

Its comprehensive Flight Analysis system provides detailed vehicle overviews, stage-by-stage performance calculations, mass and thrust analysis, and theoretical flight simulations across mission phases. NASA Mission Visualization reference data adds scientific context to planetary orbits and historical Earth–Moon trajectories.

Combining an intuitive workspace, engineering-focused analysis, interactive simulation and AI assistance, ASTRION aims to make space mission design more engaging while maintaining transparency about simplified physics and educational mission requirements. It transforms complex space engineering concepts into an interactive learning and exploration experience.
details:
ASTRION — Advanced Spacecraft Technology, Research & Interactive Orbital Navigation is an interactive space mission design platform developed for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

Users can select an Earth-orbit, Moon or Mars mission, explore spacecraft components, assemble custom rockets in an interactive engineering workspace, and examine their vehicle through Flight Analysis. ASTRION includes sample rocket designs, Blueprint AI for creating custom spacecraft components from technical design inputs, and AI assistance to help users understand engineering information. Its theoretical flight simulation provides a way to explore mission performance and outcomes.

The project aims to make space mission design more accessible and engaging by bringing spacecraft assembly, engineering analysis and simulation into one platform. It combines interactive 3D visualisation, educational physics calculations, AI-assisted explanations and NASA Mission Viz reference data.

Tools and technologies: Google AI Studio, AI-assisted development, web technologies, and NASA Mission Viz reference data.

ASTRION was designed with an emphasis on usability, scientific context, interactive learning and clear presentation of complex space engineering concepts. Its simulations are educational models and do not establish real-world mission feasibility.
